look_here_first: Robust broad-leaved spiderwort, usually taller and wider-leaved than granite spiderwort.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Exact records from Travis, Kerr, and Bexar counties.

best_field_traits: midstem leaves commonly 2 to 5 cm wide
stems commonly glabrous or nearly so
morphology_keys.comparison_training: Taller and broader-leaved than T. pedicellata; generally more robust and less consistently hairy than T. hirsutiflora.
